text_block_list.text:
Today, it's raining heavier than it has in a
while.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It shouldn't affect our plan to weight train
indoors, though. Or so I
thought...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ah, how lustrously glossy my hair looks
when it's wet...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The skies were crying to look upon my
loveliness, and it's the duty of
a ruler to
bring comfort—even to the heavens.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
My ensemble with the rain began the
moment I set foot out the door.
It was a
sight to behold.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: You should've seen me running with the storming wind, adorned in raindrops. There's no other word for it, but... perfect!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: You were running in this weather?!

text_block_list.text: How could I not?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Be they in drenching rain or on muddy
tracks, my strides have
stunning
power—they're beauty incarnate.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Whenever a poor soul longs to see my
running... I shall be there,
standing in the
spotlight, wherever the stage may be.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: No matter how bad it gets outside?

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha ha! That goes without
question.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
For I am to become the Centurial
Overlord, an unequalled source of

radiance to the world.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Even the heaviest downpours and bitterest
blizzards must yield to the
sun in the end.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Don't you see? If I cannot conquer the
weather, how am I to conquer
the track?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
...But wait, Trainer. That awestruck look in
your eyes—you've become
utterly
infatuated with me.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: I'm dumbstruck by your intense passion.

text_block_list.text: Hah, you flatter me.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Though you needn't play coy. Hesitate not
to voice your
thoughts—hold back your
boundless praise no longer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Compliments and accolades, after all, exist
for my sake! Now is the
time, Train—achoo!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
While she's been talking, a large puddle
has formed at her feet from
how wet she is.
She's sure to catch a cold at this rate...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Maybe you should change into dry clothes.

text_block_list.text:
What? I do not see the need for that... Ah!
Could it be, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Has my glistening appearance stirred your
soul? Has it roused a bout
of bashfulness
in you?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I understand what you must feel! Before
my unattainable beauty, are
you ashamed
to look so plain?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: T-Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I push her out of the room before she can
launch into another
full-blown soliloquy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
How could you drive me away like that to
get dry clothes? I still think
you've made a
grave mistake.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
You let the chance of a lifetime, to bask in
my rain-drenched glory,
escape you
forever.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: It's no good to anyone if you get sick.

text_block_list.text:
Oh, please. You shouldn't fear something
so inconceivable. There's
only one future
you need trust in.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
That I am going to become the Centurial
Overlord and shine my light
upon the
world.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: With that settled, I've important training to do. What would people say if they saw me skipping a day's hard work?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: But your jersey's still all wet...

text_block_list.text:
Forsooth, my uniform shall have to suffice!
Perhaps I'll go for a
youthful frolic by the
riverbed...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The flutter of my skirt and the power of
my strides contrasted with the
delicate
rain. Aaah, what a superb mise-en-scene it
will be!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
After that rambling, I'm almost too worn
out to say otherwise, but I'm
desperate
and summon my last ounce of courage to
stop her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
